Extract right-to-left text direction

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"extract_metadata\":true}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<html lang=\"ar\" dir=\"rtl\"><head><title>RTL Document</title></head><body><p>This is right-to-left text.</p></body></html>", options: _options)
print(result)
```
